main_text.l: SALUTARIS MEDITATIO, TRACTATIO, ET PIA, EQUE FONTIBUS
Israëlis potissimum hausta explicatio diversorum in
genere humano Statuum, sive sacrorum ac venerabilium Ordinum, ab ipso Deo in primaevo mundi flore constitutorum, & hactenus tot seculorum revolutionibus mirabiliter conservatorum, puta

l.i: Hac tibi scribo, sperans fore, ut celerius ad te veniam: Quod si tardius venero, ut noris, quomodo oportet in domo Dei versari, quae est Ecclesia Dei vivi, columna & stabilimentum veritatis.

page.notes: Woodcut medallion with a seated figure in a circular border with zodiac-like signs, between the place line and the printer line. The brace diagram reads "Status" with items Oeconomici, Politici, Ecclesiastici, Scholastici. Place line is set in a decorative black-letter-like typeface and is rendered approximately. Date MDCVIII is printed with a flourish after it.
